note: README: N = Normal. Explicit normal class of a Crohn capsule exam (frames of Crohn patients; the README does not say whether healthy controls are included)
README: E = Erytheme (French code). Same lesion type as see-ai class erythema
README: O = (O)edema (French code); slug uses the American spelling edema
README: AU = Aphthoid ulceration. Kept apart from `erosion` (clinically close: small aphthae); pooled with the ulcers only through finding_parent
README: U3-10 = ulceration between 3 mm and 10 mm; size class in finding_subtype
README: U>10 = ulceration over 10 mm; size class in finding_subtype
